data.description: GREEN (behavioral-testing-standard Rule 5 — harness invocation IS the test): Create tests/drift_injection/inject-and-heal.sh (chmod +x) dispatching on subcommand orphan|mislabel|missing-prop. Implement orphan subcommand fully; mislabel and missing-prop emit 'not yet implemented' and exit 2. Create tests/drift_injection/lib/jira-api.sh (chmod +x) with create-issue, set/unset-label, and read/strip-property Jira REST helpers. Create tests/drift_injection/lib/sandbox-cleanup.sh (chmod +x) for EXIT-trap cleanup. Orphan subcommand: create Jira issue with no local ticket, record key, run python -m dso_reconciler reconcile_once, assert bridge-fsck exit 0. Gate entire harness: if JIRA_API_TOKEN or DRIFT_TEST_PROJECT_KEY unset, print SKIP message and exit 0 (CI skip-not-fail). EXIT trap must be installed before first Jira-mutating call.
data.title: inject-and-heal.sh dispatcher + Jira/cleanup libs + orphan-mode end-to-end
